name: 74HC00
notes: Quad 2-input NAND. Unused inputs must go to VCC or GND, never float.
spice:
.subckt CHIP_74HC00 a1 b1 y1 a2 b2 y2 gnd y3 a3 b3 y4 a4 b4 vcc
Rs vcc gnd 100k
B1 d1 gnd V = v(vcc,gnd)*(1 - lunes_step(v(a1,gnd)-v(vcc,gnd)/2,30)*lunes_step(v(b1,gnd)-v(vcc,gnd)/2,30))
R1 d1 y1 50
B2 d2 gnd V = v(vcc,gnd)*(1 - lunes_step(v(a2,gnd)-v(vcc,gnd)/2,30)*lunes_step(v(b2,gnd)-v(vcc,gnd)/2,30))
R2 d2 y2 50
B3 d3 gnd V = v(vcc,gnd)*(1 - lunes_step(v(a3,gnd)-v(vcc,gnd)/2,30)*lunes_step(v(b3,gnd)-v(vcc,gnd)/2,30))
R3 d3 y3 50
B4 d4 gnd V = v(vcc,gnd)*(1 - lunes_step(v(a4,gnd)-v(vcc,gnd)/2,30)*lunes_step(v(b4,gnd)-v(vcc,gnd)/2,30))
R4 d4 y4 50
.ends CHIP_74HC00
